note: Each shot is the real game staged deterministically: game/index.html takes ?shot=<name>&seed=<n>, sets up a fixed scene and renders one clean frame (page chrome hidden by the body.shot class). scripts/shots.mjs captures them.

shots.name: title
shots.scene: The title screen over the south-east marina: water, beach, palms and the city grid behind the logo and menu.

shots.name: street
shots.scene: On foot on a downtown pavement at the start of mission 1: pedestrians, traffic, the HUD and the minimap, Mara Voss's first message on the phone toast.

shots.name: driving
shots.scene: Behind the wheel in flowing traffic on a palm-lined avenue, mission marker ahead on the road and on the minimap.

shots.name: chase
shots.scene: A three-star chase: police cars closing in, sirens on, the wanted stars lit and police blips crowding the minimap.
